name: sistema-ventas-comisiones
description: Sistema de ventas por comisión para Sakura Makeup

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sakura/api && npm run build -w @sakura/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sakura/api && npm run lint -w @sakura/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sakura/api && npm run test -w @sakura/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sakura/api && npm run typecheck -w @sakura/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run prisma:validate && npm run test && npm run build
